title: Summit acquisition synergy breakeven
prompt:
Determine the actionable cost-synergy case for Summit and tell me whether it clears our EPS and five-year equity IRR hurdles.

Use the July corporate-development investment-committee correspondence, the 7/5 controller-tied IC book, the current data-room export, the diligence review notes, and the approved underwriting policy. Treat the 6/29 banker case as change history only.

Build the year-two actionable synergy from diligence-supported cost initiatives and their realization probabilities. Keep cross-sell, unapproved pricing, and other revenue synergies out of the base case.

Calculate the annual pre-tax cost synergy required for zero adjusted EPS dilution using the pro forma share count, target after-tax earnings, financing cost, and tax rate. Separately solve the constant annual pre-tax synergy required for the five-year equity cash flows to meet the 12% IRR hurdle, including the base target cash flows and terminal proceeds. Show headroom to both hurdles and conclude which hurdles are met.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `actionable_year_two_synergy`, `eps_breakeven_synergy`, `irr_hurdle_synergy`, `eps_synergy_headroom`, `irr_synergy_headroom`, `hurdles_met`. Use dollar amounts to two decimals.
